items.title: 415 Highway 151
items.description: Welcome to the beautiful home on 18+ acres which is surrounded by natural settings, privacy and the serene setting of the Chattahoochee National Forest which adjoins the property on the south side and rear. The property represents a perfect blend of country but only approximately 15 minutes to interstate travel. This home was custom built by the owner with lovely cathedral ceiling in the foyer and living room with gas log fireplace. You will enjoy a roomy eat in kitchen with Jenn-Air electric range, dishwasher and refrigerator and you can also enjoy the formal dining room. The laundry room is off the kitchen which exits into the garage.There is an office/study that could be converted into an additional bedroom. The primary bedroom is located on the mail level with full bathroom and walk in closet. Upstairs you will find 2 large bedrooms with walk in closets and additional attic storage connected with a stunning catwalk overlooking the living/great room and a full bathroom. The attic over the garage could be converted to additional living space. Exterior features a wrap porch with a large rear screened and open porch to enjoy the private wooded back acreage. Detached carport and storage shed. The full utility basement features a wood burning heater. SELLER IS ALSO PROVIDING A 1 YEAR HOME WARRANTY VALUE UP TO $700.00 The owner welcomes you to view the property and wishes the new owner to make years of memories as she did with her family.

items.title: 674 Autumn Wood Drive
items.description: Luxury, space and exceptional amenities define this STUNNING 4-bedroom, 3.5-bath home in The Ridges, beautifully situated on 2.21 acres. Built in 2003, this two-story home with finished basement offers approximately 3,000 finished sq. ft., plus an additional floored, unfinished room above the garage providing exceptional storage or future expansion. Another stand out feature includes 2 laundry areas....one on the main level and one in the basement. The main level showcases solid hardwood and tile floors, an elegant open living and dining area with crown molding, and an electric smart-app fireplace with specialty lighting. A private office and spacious kitchen with gleaming-granite counters, pantry, built-in desk/buffet, island and breakfast bar area, add both style and function. Upstairs, 3 spacious bedrooms feature walk-in closets, including a luxurious primary suite with dual vanities, soaking tub, large tiled shower and generous walk-in closet. The finished basement offers a second living area, fourth bedroom with walk-in closet, full bath, gym/workout room, spacious laundry and utility/storage area with roll-up door. Outdoor living is truly impressive, with a large entertaining deck overlooking the fenced 18' x 36' in-ground pool and pool house featuring a half bath, storage and covered entertaining/grilling area. Surrounded by beautiful hardwoods, the wooded backyard provides a private, peaceful setting for relaxing and entertaining. A remarkable approx. 25x42 metal garage, built in 2022, offers concrete floors, power, 12' roll-up doors and 30-amp RV hookup, plus water and spigot. And Smart-home amenities include some app-controlled lighting, irrigation and backyard misting system, along with a custom dog kennel. Updates include a 2020 roof, upstairs HVAC around 2020 and main-level HVAC in 2016. This property is a rare opportunity combining refined living, privacy, entertaining and unmatched storage. Do not delay and call today for a private viewing
items.listingOffice: Joanna Jackson, RE/MAX Real Estate Center

items.title: 523 Bryant Road
items.description: Come home to the kind of country living that's getting harder to find--5 private acres, scenic views, peaceful surroundings, and a home filled with warmth and rustic charm. The inviting rocking-chair front porch is made for slow mornings and quiet evenings, while inside, warm tongue-and-groove cathedral ceilings and a large brick fireplace give the open-concept kitchen and living area the character and comfort of a true country home. Built on a slab for easy, step-free entry, all bedrooms are conveniently located on the main level. The spacious primary suite offers a beautifully tiled shower, large walk-in closet with washer and dryer hookups right where you need them. Upstairs, a versatile flex room provides extra space for a home office, game room, guest area, or whatever fits your lifestyle. Spray foam insulation in the exterior walls and ceiling adds year-round energy efficiency and comfort. Out back, the relaxing covered porch is the perfect place for grilling with friends, gathering with family, or simply sitting back and enjoying the peaceful views. With 5 acres to call your own, there's plenty of room to spread out, enjoy the outdoors, and leave the hustle and bustle behind. If you've been looking for privacy, scenic country views, rustic character, and a place that truly feels like home, this one checks all the boxes.

items.title: 2323 River Bluffs Drive
items.description: OPEN HOUSE 7/18 2-4 EST! Welcome to 2323 River Bluffs Dr., a stunning blend of luxury, functionality, and income potential in the prestigious Jasper Highlands. Behind the gates of this sought-after mountaintop community, this four-bedroom, 3.5-bath retreat offers an open-concept layout, soaring 10-foot ceilings, and a seamless mix of hardwood and ceramic tile flooring. The main level is designed for both everyday comfort and elevated entertaining, featuring a spacious great room, chef's kitchen with a walk-in pantry, and a separate dining room. A dedicated home office near the entry provides the perfect workspace, while three main-floor bedrooms include a lavish primary suite with a soaking tub, an oversized two-person shower with dual shower heads, and a massive walk-in closet. Upstairs, a private-entry guest suite awaits--complete with a bedroom, full bath, sitting area, and fireplace. Ideal for extended family, guests, or potential rental income, this space offers both warmth and independence. Outdoor living is effortless with dual access to the expansive covered back porch, perfect for relaxing or entertaining, along with a welcoming covered front porch. A three-car garage provides ample storage for vehicles and gear. Adding to the tranquility and privacy, the land beside the home is protected and cannot be built on, ensuring unobstructed views and a lasting sense of serenity. Set within the amenity-rich Jasper Highlands, this home grants access to community pools, scenic walking trails, tennis and pickleball courts, shuffleboard, a fitness center, and two on-site restaurants. Whether you're seeking a private escape or a property with earning potential, this exceptional home delivers.

items.title: 9013 Brow Lake Road
items.description: Rare opportunity to own in Montlake Golf & Country Club Estates below neighborhood values. Situated on over an acre overlooking the 10th fairway, this 3,200-square-foot residence offers exceptional bones, an outstanding location, county only taxes and the chance to personalize a home in one of the area's premier golf course communities. With neighboring homes selling for much more, buyers have a unique opportunity to build equity while creating a home tailored to their style. Designed with a flexible floor plan, the home features a spacious primary suite on the main level. Upstairs, you'll find a second oversized primary suite, two additional generously sized bedrooms, and another full bath, providing a total of four bedrooms and four full bathrooms--ideal for multi-generational living, growing families, or hosting guests. Outdoor enthusiasts will also appreciate the close proximity to Stone Fort (Little Rock City), one of the Southeast's premier destinations for hiking, rock climbing, and exploring the natural beauty of the Cumberland Plateau. Schedule your showing for your next big opportunity today. Being sold As-Is.

items.title: 177 N Crest Road
items.description: Welcome to this breathtaking view on Missionary Ridge! Sweeping city and mountain views create an incredible backdrop for this fully renovated home, a rare opportunity to enjoy scenery from your back porch that feels straight out of a magazine. The open floor plan on the main level maximizes the views, with real hardwood flooring throughout the kitchen and main living areas. Custom kitchen cabinets, quartz countertops, and handmade backsplash tile bring warmth and character to the heart of the home. The spacious primary suite feels grand with its vaulted ceiling, private balcony, and beautifully renovated bathroom. An additional upstairs bedroom next to the primary suite offers an equally impressive view, while two bedrooms in the basement provide additional space and flexibility. All bathrooms have been fully renovated, with brand-new light fixtures throughout the entire home and updated plumbing fixtures. Outside, two levels of oversized decks have been completely rebuilt with Trex decking, creating an exceptional outdoor living experience for entertaining, dining, or simply relaxing above the city. A new roof, new gutters, and two new HVAC units complete the extensive improvements. Come experience these remarkable views and make this dream home yours today!

Situated on nearly an acre of lush landscape, the property features serene water views and a private creek, providing a tranquil setting for relaxation and outdoor enjoyment. Unwind in the soothing hot tub, gather around the cozy fire pit, or enjoy the stunning natural surroundings from one of two expansive decks. Inside, a warm fireplace adds to the cabin's charm, creating a cozy ambiance for those cool mountain evenings. Currently operating as a successful Airbnb under a Superhost, this property presents an exceptional opportunity for buyers seeking a vacation home, mountain retreat, or established short-term rental. Offered fully furnished, this cabin allows the next owner to step right in and start experiencing the beauty and tranquility of North Georgia's outdoors. Whether you're searching for your dream mountain escape or a lucrative short-term rental investment, this delightful creekside cabin in Ellijay is ready for its next chapter. With its combination of luxurious finishes, spacious living areas, multiple ensuite bedrooms, versatile bonus space, and an unbeatable location near I-75 and downtown Ringgold, this home is one you won't want to miss. Schedule your private showing today!

items.title: 653 Briar Road
items.description: MOUNTAIN PRIVACY JUST 30 MINUTES FROM DOWNTOWN CHATTANOOGA! Nestled on 4.5 wooded acres atop Mowbray Mountain, this 3,964-square-foot farmhouse-style home offers privacy and comfort. The semi-wraparound porch features a tongue-and-groove ceiling and seating overlooking the woods; positioned toward the creek, you can hear rushing water after a good rain. Inside, the living room features a large picture window overlooking the wooded backyard and opens to the gourmet kitchen. An oversized quartz island provides workspace, seating, and cabinetry. Features include deep drawers, floating shelves, custom hood vent, apron-front/farmhouse sink, soft-close cabinetry, spice drawer, pull-out utensil cabinet, stainless steel appliances, and large walk-in pantry. A nearby sitting/breakfast nook provides casual dining space, while an arched opening leads to the formal dining room. The main-level primary suite includes a nook for reading, sitting, office, nursery, or potential closet space. The primary bath features an oversized tiled walk-in shower and double-bowl furniture-style vanity. A second spacious bedroom has direct access to a full bath, which also opens to the mudroom near the garage entrance. Upstairs includes two bedrooms, full bath, dedicated office, separate flex area, climate-controlled storage, and an enormous bonus/family room for entertaining, recreation, hobbies, or additional living space. The oversized three-car garage has soaring ceilings, insulated/drywalled walls, and room for vehicles, equipment, hobbies, or projects. A separate butcher/canning room has a floor drain and sink plumbing, plus oversized loft storage above. Outside, a cleared trail winds through the acreage to a rear bluff, where minimal clearing could further open the view. Approximately 30 minutes from downtown Chattanooga and 20 minutes from Dunlap. Schedule your private tour today. All information deemed reliable but not guaranteed. Buyer to verify all information.

items.title: 0 Flagpole Road
items.description: Positioned in the storied foothills of the Blue Ridge Mountains just minutes north of historic downtown Ellijay, this 79.8± acre contiguous holding represents an increasingly scarce land asset in the North Georgia highlands. Held under uninterrupted single-family stewardship for well over four decades, the property remains in an undisturbed, primitive recreational state--anchored by an unharvested timber hardwood forest and high knolls commanding expansive, multi-layered mountain views. While functioning as an uncompromised family retreat or recreational reserve, the tract possesses an exceptional commercial and investment dimension. Unincorporated Gilmer County has matured into one of the premier mountain vacation and eco-tourism corridors in the Southeast, fueled by year-round demand from Atlanta, Chattanooga, and beyond. Located directly along the Flagpole Road short-term rental (STR) corridor, the property's dramatic topography yields multiple natural ridge benches and secluded home sites. This layout allows for low-density luxury chalets, a high-end cabin compound, or a private boutique hospitality enclave where every build site enjoys total visual seclusion and protected view sheds. Whether viewed through the lens of a long-term conservation and timber asset, a generational family compound, or a carefully staged vacation rental development, this 80-acre holding presents an irreplaceable canvas in Georgia's apple and wine country. Location & Regional Synergy The Heart of Apple & Wine Country: Minutes from the historic brick-paved square of Ellijay--renowned for its boutique dining, antique shops, thriving craft breweries, and world-class heritage apple orchards and vineyards. Blue Ridge & Mountain Towns: Located a short, scenic drive south of Blue Ridge, Georgia, offering Lake Blue Ridge access, fine dining, the Blue Ridge Scenic Railway, and upscale mountain hospitality. The Regional Playground: Positioned within 20 to 30 minutes of Carters Lake--the deepest lake in Georgia spanning 3,200 surface acres with zero private shoreline development, renowned for trophy striped bass fishing and deep-water boating. Bordered by the Coosawattee and Cartecay River watersheds, the area is a celebrated southeastern hub for native cold-water trout angling, kayaking, and whitewater paddling. Immediate Metro Transit: Situated under 75 miles north of Atlanta via the continuous 4-lane GA-515/Highway 515 corridor, and less than 1.5 hours southeast of Chattanooga, placing the property within an easy, friction-free 2-hour drive for over 6 million regional residents. Property & Investment Highlights Undisturbed Mature Canopy: 40+ years of uninterrupted growth has established an exceptional canopy of white oak, red oak, hickory, and mountain hardwoods, creating an authentic Appalachian woodland aesthetic. Topography & Views: Elevated ridges and defined knolls offer dramatic elevation change, opening up broad seasonal and year-round panoramic views of the Blue Ridge mountain ridges. Proven STR Development Potential: Direct frontage along the established Flagpole Road short-term rental corridor. This scenic mountain stretch has emerged as a premier corridor for investors. The natural bench-and-ridge topography allows an investor to construct multiple high-yield rental cabins with natural topography buffers providing complete guest privacy. Unincorporated County Jurisdiction: Located in unincorporated Gilmer County under current A1 Agricultural zoning, providing a streamlined pathway for residential, agricultural, conservation, and county-compliant Chapter 45 STR host licensing. Wildlife & Sport: A thriving sanctuary for native whitetail deer, wild turkey, and black bear, benefiting from large surrounding timber holdings and minimal historic hunting pressure. BROKER COMMENT: "With 40 years of untouched timber and commanding ridge views just minutes from downtown Ellijay, land offering this level of privacy and development freedom is hard to replicate." The Facts/Overview 79.8± contiguous acres in the foothills of the Blue Ridge Mountains, just north of Ellijay, Georgia, in Gilmer County Held in single-family ownership for more than 40 years Undeveloped recreational property with mature hardwood timber Mature canopy includes white oak, red oak, hickory, and mountain hardwoods Elevated ridges and knolls provide multiple potential homesites and mountain views Seasonal and year-round views of surrounding Blue Ridge Mountain ridges Located along Flagpole Road, an established short-term rental corridor Natural ridge and bench topography offers potential for multiple secluded homesites or cabins Zoned A1 Agricultural Potential uses include a private family compound, recreational retreat, conservation property, or residential/hospitality development, subject to applicable approvals Minutes from downtown Ellijay, with access to restaurants, breweries, shops, orchards, and vineyards Short drive to Blue Ridge and Lake Blue Ridge Approximately 20-30 minutes from Carters Lake, a 3,200-acre reservoir known for boating and striped bass fishing Located near the Coosawattee and Cartecay River watersheds, with access to trout fishing, kayaking, and paddling Less than 75 miles north of Atlanta via GA-515/Highway 515 Less than 1.5 hours southeast of Chattanooga Area supports year-round recreational and vacation demand from Atlanta, Chattanooga, and surrounding markets Wildlife includes whitetail deer, wild turkey, and black bear

items.title: 181 County Road 5
items.description: Perched atop 15 breathtaking acres with panoramic views that stretch for miles, this extraordinary hilltop retreat offers the perfect blend of luxury, privacy, and East Tennessee beauty sitting above a natural underground stream. Welcome to 181 County Hwy 5-where peaceful county living meets exceptional craftsmanship. This stunning 3 bedroom, 3 full bath custom home, which was originally built in 1900 was completely redone from the studs out 10 years ago, offers approximately 2,100 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space filled with warmth and character. Rich hardwood floors flow throughout, while the inviting floor plan creates the perfect setting for both everyday living and entertaining. At the heart of the home, the living room welcomes you with a beautiful fireplace, creating a cozy gathering space framed by picturesque views. The primary suite is a true retreat featuring its own private fireplace, offering the perfect place to unwind at the end of the day. Outside, the homes striking curb appeal shines with its impressive timber-framed entry, expansive covered porches and beautiful landscaping. Surrounded by rolling countryside and unmatched scenery, every moment here feels like a getaway. Whether enjoying morning coffee while watching the sunrises or enjoying a peaceful evening watching breathtaking sunsets, or cooking in your outdoor kitchen, this property offers a lifestyle that is increasingly hard to find. Private, Peaceful, Breathtaking. 181 Highway 5 is more than a home-it is a retreat.

items.title: 8074 Fox Glove Drive
items.description: The best homes aren't defined by their size--they're defined by how well they live. 8074 Fox Glove Drive is one of those homes. Offering 3,264 square feet, four bedrooms, three full baths, a powder room, a highly sought-after main-level owner's suite, and an oversized bonus room that offers the flexibility to serve as a home office, media room, playroom, guest suite, or even a fifth bedroom, this home is designed to adapt to the way you live. The main floor was designed for the way people actually live. The spacious layout is open enough to comfortably host holiday gatherings, family celebrations, and evenings with friends, yet it still feels warm, connected, and comfortable for everyday life. The large kitchen naturally becomes the heart of the home, while the cozy gas fireplace and formal dining room with its coffered ceiling create inviting spaces to gather. The highly desirable main-level owner's suite provides the convenience of single-level living with a spacious bedroom, sitting area, large walk-in closet, and private bath--creating a comfortable retreat at the end of the day. Upstairs, you'll find three generously sized bedrooms, including one with its own private ensuite bath, while the oversized bonus room provides even more space to fit your lifestyle. The screened porch and fully fenced backyard extend your living space outdoors, providing the perfect place to relax, entertain, or let children and pets enjoy the yard. A two-car garage and additional paved parking offer extra room for guests, a third vehicle, or recreational equipment. Located in the established Meadow Stream community, this home offers convenient access to excellent schools, shopping, dining, and everything Ooltewah has to offer. It's a home you'll enjoy just as much on an ordinary Tuesday evening as you will on Thanksgiving Day.
items.listingOffice: Jay L Hudson, Keller Williams Realty

items.title: 149 N Crest Road
items.description: Perched atop Missionary Ridge, this beautifully updated home pairs timeless character with today's most sought-after improvements. Over the years, the owners have invested extensively in the property, including new roof, replacement of nearly every window, fresh interior and exterior paint, refinished hardwood floors, a premium TimberTech deck, a new second driveway, and a freshly tiled front porch. Thoughtful custom touches, including custom window treatments and built-in closet systems, further enhance the home's style and functionality. With major improvements already completed, buyers can enjoy the charm of this historic home with the confidence that many big-ticket items have already been made. Enjoy front-row views of Chattanooga's skyline, spectacular sunsets, and seasonal fireworks from the new Lookouts' Erlanger Park- all from the comfort of home.

items.title: 8206 Ooltewah Georgetown Road
items.description: Exceptional 14.5-acre opportunity nestled at the base of scenic White Oak Mountain! This versatile property offers a mix of cleared land and mature woods, perfect for a custom estate or new residential project. Features established access to main road for right-of-way/easement potential or possibility for stub-out at rear of parcel. Ideally situated just minutes from downtown Ooltewah, I-75, and HWY 58--offering an easy commute to both Chattanooga and Cleveland. Property for sale consists of approximately 14.5 acres to be subdivided from portions of two adjoining parcels: 104 083 and 104 083.01. Final acreage and legal description subject to survey prior to closing.
